assumptions: CBSA land area sums Census county ALAND for every county assigned by county representative point.

provenance.transformation: TIGER/Line CBSA code and polygon; representative point on surface in EPSG:5070 transformed to WGS84.

assumptions: Station status must be E and access must be public.

provenance.source_name: U.S. DOE Alternative Fuels Data Center
provenance.transformation: Count active public stations' reported DC fast ports after point-in-polygon joins to CBSA and counties.

assumptions: A metro label is matched to the official page's city/state label.

assumptions: Threshold is exactly 90 F (32.222... C), not a rounded 32.0 C threshold.
Station eligibility and climate-normal completeness follow NOAA's published normals product.
provenance.transformation: Use ANN-TMAX-AVGNDS-GRTH090, NOAA's 1991-2020 mean annual number of days with daily maximum temperature >= 90 F; average qualifying station counts for the CBSA proxy.

assumptions: TIGER All Lines contains unique topological edges rather than duplicate named road features.
CBSAs are composed of whole member counties, so no within-county polygon clipping is applied.
Freeway proxy=S1100+S1630; arterial proxy=S1200; local/residual=S1400+S1640+S1730.
Intersections count distinct endpoint TNIDs with degree >=3; nearby qualifying nodes within 20 m are merged; nodes within 5 m of the CBSA boundary are excluded.
All member counties must be present for the CBSA network to be complete.
provenance.source_name: U.S. Census TIGER/Line All Lines county edges
provenance.transformation: Select unique ROADFLG topological edges from the CBSA's complete member counties, project to EPSG:32616, and aggregate qualifying MTFCC edge lengths and TNID endpoint degrees.

assumptions: Selected station USW00013876 (BIRMINGHAM AP) is 12.02 km from the CBSA representative point.
The station normal is a proxy for the CBSA, not an area-weighted CBSA measurement.
provenance.source_name: NOAA NCEI Annual Normals Station Inventory
provenance.transformation: Select nearest station within 100 km reporting ANN-SNOW-NORMAL for this feature using great-circle distance.

assumptions: A NOAA-reported numeric 0.0 is retained as zero; blank or -9999 values mean missing/insufficient data and are not converted to zero.
provenance.transformation: Read ANN-SNOW-NORMAL in inches from the 1991-2020 station normal and convert to millimeters (multiply by 25.4).

assumptions: Published ACS 5-year profile estimate is used directly; no imputation or zero substitution.
